description: Paid ($0.01 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): for expensive calls. The pre-payment verdict (go, caution or no_go) plus the full diagnosis, the 30-day history per day, how reliable the seller's other endpoints are and whether the endpoint moved domains. Never pays the endpoint. Same as GET /api/v1/preflight/deep. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

max_usd.description: Your budget per call in USD, e.g. 0.5

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

network.description: CAIP-2 network you want to pay on, e.g. eip155:8453

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_preflight_deep
title: Deep check of an x402 endpoint before an expensive payment ($0.01 via x402)
